selection: Only valid channel maximum>256 and packed NAV empty; single and batch; all original templates/allocations/transfers/streams and other dispatch retained.

precision_scope: Same sample/channel counts,FP64 time/chip/carrier phase,ordered FP32 products/sums,Philox draws/seed/sequence,returned IQ ownership. Exact tested IQ/metadata/rejections; no new long real-data positioning-error distribution.
